The real assignee search excluded the inactive identity; the current historical option was disabled and selected.

Explicitly resubmitting the inactive lead with the current validator returned422 without metadata or brief mutation.

UI No lead sent an explicit null with the current validator, persisted null through reload and advanced metadata once. The inactive identity was absent from both eligible results and historical-current options after clearing.
